verdict.rationale: Figma's own prototyping docs state it builds and shares high-fidelity, no-code, interactive prototypes, which covers the core of wiring screens into clickable prototypes without code. None of the evidence names the specific mechanics in the story: interaction triggers, screen transitions or overlays. The motion and animation claim on the design page is related but does not confirm prototype transitions. Missing for 10: documented interaction triggers, documented transition types between screens, documented overlay support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can wire screens into clickable prototypes with triggers, transitions, and overlays — no code required

citations.quote: Figma's prototyping tools make it easy to build and share high-fidelity, no-code, interactive prototypes.
Figma allows designers to create and prototype their digital experiences - together in real-time and in one place
